```{r}
library(readr)
```

```{r}
eclipse_data <- read_csv("data/formatted_eclipses.csv")
country_data <- read_csv("data/total_eclipses_by_country.csv")
```


```{r}
#| label: facts-cards-grid
#| column: screen-inset
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 2

make_fact_card <- function(fact_text, fill = "#2c3e50", text_color = "white") {
  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(
        aes(
            xmin = 0,
            xmax = 2,
            ymin = 0,
            ymax = 1),
            fill = fill
            ) +
    annotate("text",
            x = 1,
            y = 0.5,
            label = str_wrap(fact_text, width = 30),
            color = text_color,
            family = "Avenir Next",
            size = 4,
            hjust = 0.5, 
            vjust = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
}

eclipse_facts <- c(
  "224 solar eclipses",
  "77 partial",
  "72 annular",
  "68 total",
  "7 hybrids"
)

colors <- c("#3d3a4b","#d3c0cd","#e3dfff")

text_color_for <- function(fill) {
  rgb <- col2rgb(fill) / 255
  luminance <- 0.2126 * rgb["red", ] + 0.7152 * rgb["green", ] + 0.0722 * rgb["blue", ]
  ifelse(luminance > 0.5, "black", "white")
}

fills <- rep_len(colors, length(eclipse_facts))
text_colors <- text_color_for(fills)
cards <- Map(make_fact_card, eclipse_facts, fills, text_colors)

wrap_plots(cards, ncol = 5)

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4

eclipse_data <- eclipse_data %>%
  mutate(
    hover = paste(
      "Type:",
      Type,
      "<br>Date:",
      Date,
      "<br>Time:",
      `Time_of_greatest_eclipse_terrestrial_time`
    )
  )

eclipse_colors <- c(
  "Total" = "#3d3a4b",
  "Hybrid" = "#d3c0cd",
  "Annular" = "#937666",
  "Partial" = "#e3dfff"
)


plot_ly(
  eclipse_data,
  type = "scattermapbox",
  mode = "markers",
  lat = ~Latitude,
  lon = ~Longitude,
  color = ~Type,
  colors = eclipse_colors,
  text = ~hover,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.65)
) |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    mapbox = list(
      style = "open-street-map",
      center = list(
        lon = 0,
        lat = 0
      ),
      zoom = 1.5
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 8


country_eclipse_counts <- country_data %>%
  count(country, name = "eclipse_count")

plot_ly(
  country_eclipse_counts,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~country,
  locationmode = "country names",
  z = ~eclipse_count,
  text = ~paste(
    "Country:", country,
    "<br>Eclipses:", eclipse_count
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = list(
    c(0, 0.01, 1),
    c("white", "#E3DFFF", "#3D3A4B")
  ),
  zmin = 0,
  zmax = max(country_eclipse_counts$eclipse_count),
  marker = list(
    line = list(
      color = "white",
      width = 0.5
    )
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    title = "Solar Eclipse Density by Country",
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = TRUE,
      projection = list(
        type = "natural earth"
      )
    )
  )

```

::::

```{r}
#| label: timeline
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 8

eclipse_tab <- eclipse_data |>
  rowid_to_column() |>
  mutate(
    event = paste0("event", rowid),
    color = case_when(
      Type == "Total" ~ "#3d3a4b",
      Type == "Annular" ~ "#937666",
      Type == "Partial" ~ "#e3dfff",
      Type == "Hybrid" ~ "d3c0cd"
    )
  )

timeline_data <- data.frame(
  event = eclipse_tab$event,
  start = eclipse_tab$Date,
  type = eclipse_tab$Type,
  color = eclipse_tab$color
)

timelineplot <- vistime::vistime(
  timeline_data,
  col.event = "event",
  col.group = "type",
  optimize_y = T,
  show_labels = FALSE,
  linewidth = 5
)

pp <- plotly::plotly_build(timelineplot)
pp$x$layout$xaxis$tickfont <- list(size = 12)
pp$x$layout$yaxis$tickfont <- list(size = 12)

pp
```

```{r}
#| label: average duration time
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 10

eclipse_tab <- eclipse_tab |>
  mutate(eclipse_duration = str_replace(Central_duration_min_s, ":", ".")) |>
  mutate(eclipse_duration = as.numeric(eclipse_duration))

eclipse_colors <- c(
  "Total" = "#3d3a4b",
  "Hybrid" = "#d3c0cd",
  "Annular" = "#937666",
  "Partial" = "#e3dfff"
)

p <- eclipse_tab |>
  filter(eclipse_duration != is.na(eclipse_duration)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = eclipse_duration, fill = Type)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = mean(eclipse_duration, na.rm = TRUE)),
    color = "#e07a5f",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Duration (minutes)",
    y = "",
    title = "Eclipse Duration",
    fill = "Type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eclipse_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank())

p2 <- eclipse_tab |>
  ggplot(aes(x = "", fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Proportion",
      title = "",
      fill = "Type") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eclipse_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank())


p + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2,
                    widths = c(0.9, 0.1))
```
